name: SecJev-4B-Action-Monitor-C1
description: SecJev-4B fine-tuned (variant C1, epoch 1) to judge whether a proposed agent tool call is authorized by the user's request, given the tool outputs the agent has seen (content view).
upstream_checkpoint: SecJev-4B v1.2.0 (UESTC1010/SecJev, GitHub release v1.2.0); upstream records preserved in upstream-provenance.json and upstream-secjev-4b/

training.variant: C1: content view, lr 3e-5, no SecJev-Corpus replay, unauthorized-class weight 3, 1 epoch selected
training.data: Action-authorization questions built from recorded AgentDojo v1.2.2 runs (build_action_data.py). Train: workspace+travel suites (9,974 questions, 694 unauthorized). Dev: 915. Held-out test: banking+slack (7,588), never used for checkpoint or threshold selection.
training.threshold_reported: 0.35 on P(unauthorized) + 0.5 * P(partially), tuned on workspace+travel normal tasks only
